plan.name: multikill-definition-ablation-v1
plan.hypothesis: Multi-kill round frequency or separate size buckets may describe impact better than kills beyond the first.

definitions.size_buckets: four separate fractions with exactly 2, exactly 3, exactly 4, or at least 5 kills

plan.fixed: Other seven available families unchanged; objectives excluded because actor attribution is unavailable. Raw standardized ridge alpha=1, intercept unpenalized; eight-second existing trade definition. No operator normalization.
plan.split: Use expanded-fit-plan.json seven pre-August events: 299 clean rows, leave-one-event-out, then full fit evaluated on 32 August EWC development rows. Both September events excluded, 60 NA final rows sealed.
plan.comparison: Reuse recorded baseline models/metrics without refitting. Report pooled/event errors and raw-unit coefficient drift. No automatic winner or final-test evaluation.
plan.status: Preregistered before running either variant. No tuning alpha or adding variants based on results.

objective_status: Unavailable; omitted, not imputed from team occurrences.

plan.name: separate-opening-terms-v1
plan.hypothesis: Opening kills and opening deaths may have asymmetric marginal effects; test freeing the equal-and-opposite coefficient constraint.
plan.definition: Separate opening_kills/rounds and opening_deaths/rounds. All other available families use the original baseline, including kills beyond first. Objectives unavailable and excluded.
plan.split: Same seven pre-August events (299 rows), leave-one-event-out, full-train evaluation on August EWC (32 rows). Both September events excluded; 60 final NA rows sealed.
plan.decision: One variant only. Record fold errors, raw slopes and drift; no parameter search or final-test access. Preregistered before fitting.

plan.name: trade-window-isolated-v1
plan.hypothesis: Trade credit may be sensitive to the allowed response time; compare plausible whole-second thresholds while retaining exact killer-based refrag semantics.
plan.source: Ignored cached normalized Match JSON at data/research/derived; no raw replay parsing or public actor input. Per-round calculate_match is the source of death/kill trade credit.
plan.control: At 8 seconds, every retained round trade value must reproduce player_maps.jsonl. Reuse stored baseline model and CV record; no identical refit.
plan.isolation: Only replace (deaths_traded - kills_traded)/rounds. KOST and every other player feature stay at the cached 8-second baseline values, even though KOST would mechanically change with a production window setting. Report this as a limitation; evaluate consistency separately before any runtime change.
plan.model: Original raw eight available families, objectives omitted; standardized ridge alpha=1, intercept unpenalized. Opening differential and kills beyond first retained.
plan.split: Seven pre-August events, 299 clean rows, leave-one-event-out; full fit against 32 August EWC development rows. Both September events excluded; NA final 60 sealed.
plan.decision: Inspect per-fold and August accuracy, trade counts, coefficient drift and threshold sensitivity. A tiny pooled MAE difference alone does not select a new window.

plan.name: trade-representation-v1
plan.hypothesis: Credited teammate recovery and susceptibility to being refragged may have different associations with public Rating.
plan.control: Current (deaths_traded-kills_traded)/rounds raw baseline; reuse saved model/CV record rather than refit.

definitions.deaths_traded_rate: victim deaths whose killer was refragged by teammate within 8 seconds, divided by rounds
definitions.kills_traded_rate: player opponent kills later refragged by victim teammate within 8 seconds, divided by rounds

plan.fixed: Other seven available raw families and eight-second KOST exactly as cached, objectives excluded, standardized ridge alpha 1.
plan.split: 299 clean pre-August training rows over seven event-held-out folds; full fit on 299 then August EWC 32 development rows. Both September events excluded and final NA60 sealed.
plan.decision: Compare folds and August, interpret coefficient signs and stability, do not select solely from tiny MAE differences. Preregistered before fitting.

plan.name: kost-survival-overlap-v1
plan.hypothesis: The separate survival term may overlap with KOST's survival path; compare removing one path and removing the separate survival family.

definitions.kost_without_survival: For each player-round, 1 if opponent kill OR verified player objective OR death traded; no survival path. Keep separate survival/rounds.
definitions.kost_only: Original KOST/rounds, omit the separate survival rate.

plan.control: Original KOST/rounds plus survival/rounds. Reuse saved model and CV results without refit.
plan.fixed: All other available raw families unchanged, eight-second trade differential, kills beyond first, opening differential, objectives excluded; ridge alpha 1.
plan.split: 299 clean pre-August rows across seven event-held-out folds; fit all 299 and evaluate 32 August EWC development rows. Both September events excluded; NA final 60 sealed.
plan.decision: Compare fold and August errors, coefficient signs/stability, and objective-positive residual labels after fitting. Do not treat public objective credits as model inputs. Preregistered before fitting.

plan.name: clutch-linear-size-weight-v1
plan.hypothesis: Winning from a larger first sole-survivor disadvantage may carry more Rating weight than a 1v1 win.
plan.definition: sum(X * clutch_1vX for X=1..5)/rounds, exactly the previously tested linear size rule; no per-size coefficients.
plan.control: Original equal-credit clutches/rounds; reuse saved baseline model and CV metrics.
plan.fixed: All other available raw families unchanged: 8-second trade differential, original KOST and separate survival, kills beyond first, opening differential, objectives excluded; ridge alpha 1.
plan.split: 299 clean pre-August training rows, seven held-out-event folds, then August EWC 32 development rows. Both September events excluded; final NA60 sealed.
plan.decision: One variant only. Require consistent event and August gain before considering replacement; no size-coefficient grid search. Preregistered before fitting.
